units: Mara works methodically through the relay before blaming the line.
The local test succeeds; the fault must be farther west.
While shifting for a better look at the cable entry, she notices one floorboard is cleaner at the edges.
Eli points out that the west span took the lightning hardest.
Mara files the floorboard away as an oddity and chooses the stronger diagnostic lead.
They leave for the west span.
